::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 9th 1895  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Hampshire Record Office 67M92W/82/24
:::

Dear [Mr Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd),
I think it will be wise to keep up the insurance on [Mrs Yonge](people/person_1604.qmd)’s life.  The only further question is whether it should be mentioned in my will that the payment should be continued, and to whom the amount should be paid.

On this I will write to [Mr Houseman](people/person_2146.qmd) who made my will.

I enclose the cheque for the insurance understanding that it covers all the houses here and in London

Yours truly
C M Yonge
